bio: I'm an AI Governance & Automation Solution Architect who helps enterprises move from rule-based RPA to secure, governed agentic AI. As Manager, Intelligent Process Platform at Capgemini Invent, I design multi-agent workflows with UiPath Maestro, Agent Builder, coded agents and MCP servers, and build the Centres of Excellence that keep them compliant at scale. In 14+ years I've gone from SAP scripting to agentic architecture, and earned 23 certifications along the way, including UiPath Agentic Automation Professional, Azure AI Apps & Agents and Claude Certified Developer. I'm a 2x UiPath MVP, won the UiPath Coded Agent Challenge, and have shared {forum.solutions}+ solutions on the UiPath Forum.

experience.title: Manager - Intelligent Process Platform
highlights: Agentic AI enablement: Conducted Agentic AI enabler sessions for team members across IPP, building practical skills in UiPath agents, MCP Servers, and agentic design patterns. Followed up with a 15-day agent-build challenge to turn learning into hands-on builds.
Certification drive: Guided team members toward UiPath and AI certifications, helping developers get certified and strengthening the practice’s delivery readiness.

Agentic AI PoCs: Designed and built agentic AI proofs of concept, including a conversational Orchestrator management agent on a Coded MCP Server architecture and an intelligent invoice processing agent with human-in-the-loop validation, to show clients the value of next-generation automation.

Escalation handling: Owned technical escalations on automation engagements, diagnosing root causes, stabilizing production issues, and restoring client confidence through clear communication and corrective action plans.
Business development: Contributed to business development by identifying automation and agentic AI opportunities with existing and prospective clients, helping grow the IPP automation pipeline.
Presales support: Supported presales with solution architecture, effort estimation, RFP responses, and client demos, positioning Capgemini’s agentic automation capabilities in pursuits.
Recognition: The Transformer [Quarterly Award]

experience.title: Technical Lead
highlights: Solution architecture: Designed scalable, reusable automation architectures on UiPath (REFramework, Orchestrator queues, dispatcher–performer models) processes across Finance/HR/Supply Chain/Insurance domains.
Delivery leadership: Led a team of developers and BAs across two concurrent projects. Owned estimation, sprint planning, code reviews, and release management, and delivered releases on time.

Intelligent automation: Integrated Document Understanding, AI Center, and GenAI/LLM capabilities to automate unstructured document processing such as invoices and claims, reaching higher extraction accuracy.

Agentic automation: Architected agentic workflows that combine UiPath Agents, Maestro, and API integrations, moving clients from rule-based bots to [AI-driven decisioning or human-in-the-loop] orchestration.

Platform and infrastructure: Planned and administered Orchestrator and Automation Cloud environments, including license optimization, bot scheduling, credential vaults, and high-availability setup for unattended robots.
Governance and CoE: Set up or strengthened the Automation CoE with coding standards, reusable component libraries, a design-review gate, and monitoring dashboards, cutting defect leakage.
Pre-sales and client engagement: Supported RFPs, solution demos, and PoCs that helped win deals. Served as the primary technical point of contact for client stakeholders.
Integration: Built integrations with SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle, mainframe, and REST/SOAP APIs, using API-first approaches where possible to make bots more resilient.
Hypercare and support: Established production support processes with SLA-based incident handling, exception analytics, and bot health monitoring, keeping bot uptime highest.
Talent building: Mentored developers toward UiPath certifications and ran internal upskilling sessions on agentic automation and best practices.

text: I had the privilege of working with Ashok in the capacity of Delivery Head for IPA, and I can confidently say that Ashok is an exceptional automation leader and a leading UiPath MVP. His cutting-edge knowledge of UiPath Agentic AI, combined with a strategic vision, has consistently delivered transformative results for our organization.

What sets Ashok apart is his deep technical expertise and ability to design scalable, efficient, and robust enterprise solutions that seamlessly bridge traditional automation with advanced AI capabilities to align perfectly with business objectives.
He not only possesses mastery over the UiPath ecosystem and intelligent agentic workflows, but he also excels in stakeholder management, architectural governance, and process optimization.

Throughout our collaboration, Ashok demonstrated outstanding problem-solving skills, acute attention to detail, and a proactive approach to pioneering next-generation technologies. His ability to mentor teams, share cutting-edge insights, and foster continuous innovation makes him a true luminary in the automation space.

I highly recommend Ashok for any organization looking to stay ahead of the curve and drive true digital transformation through advanced AI and intelligent automation. He is an invaluable asset and a phenomenal team player.

text: I had the pleasure of working with Ashok for almost two years, and I can genuinely say he's one of those colleagues who makes the whole team better.

When I think about his growth over this time, what stands out most is how he evolved into the architect and senior developer he is today. He started digging deeper into how things are built, not just making them work, but making them work well and scale properly. You could see him constantly researching better approaches and pushing for more robust solutions.

Alongside the technical growth, he also stepped up in terms of ownership. He became more independent, took initiative, and you could trust him to run with things without needing to check in constantly. That kind of reliability is rare and genuinely valuable.
I'm honestly sad to see him leave the team - he was a real asset, both for what he delivered and for the energy he brought. Any team that gets to work with Ashok is lucky to have him.

I am delighted to recommend Ashok for his exemplary performance as a UiPath Developer and Team Lead. He possesses deep expertise in RPA and has consistently delivered scalable, high-quality automation solutions aligned with business objectives. In his leadership role, he effectively managed team deliverables, fostered collaboration, and ensured timely and efficient project execution.

Ashok is also highly regarded for his commitment to capability building—he has actively mentored team members and played a pivotal role in imparting UiPath knowledge, thereby strengthening the team's overall proficiency. His professionalism, problem-solving approach, and dedication make him a strong asset to any organization.

I had the pleasure of working alongside Ashok, and I can confidently say he is one of the most resourceful and knowledgeable colleagues I've had. What truly sets him apart is his ability to think outside the box no matter how complex a challenge, he always comes up with creative, alternative approaches that others might overlook.

Ashok has a deep understanding of his domain, and he pairs that expertise with a genuine willingness to help. He's the kind of person who doesn't just solve problems, he makes sure everyone around him understands the solution too. His collaborative spirit and positive attitude make him a joy to work with.
Beyond his technical strengths, Ashok brings reliability and calm to the team, especially under pressure. Any team would be fortunate to have him.

I am pleased to recommend Ashok, Ashok is very experienced, calm and composed professional. I had worked with him for various RPA Automations and all of them were complex, He was able to deliver best performance. His in-depth knowledge on UiPath, SAP and relevant suggestions during review sessions, raised the bar in our deliverables.
Ashok is hard working, proactive, always ready to take challenges and always ready to delivery beyond his duty!

Finally, I would say - Ashok is excellent team player and possess potential to deliver high quality work, It is a treat for any manager to have Ashok on his/her project as nothing less of perfect can come of him.

Ashok has been one of the best developer I have come across, he really uses his imagination for perfect solution implementation of any RPA Bot, his codes are very neat and very easy to understand for another developer. He can work under immense pressure and can deliver projects on time without any delays.
